description: Showreel briefs: three studios in different looks and aspects, and the common gallery prompt with no name.

briefs.brief: Showreel opener for Lantern Works, a stop-motion and collage studio. Their work is handmade, surprising and warm. Paper look.
15-second vertical reel for Kiln Motion, a two-person studio doing title design and brand animation. Words: bold, warm, exact. Studio look, upbeat.
Personal showreel for Mara Quint, a freelance motion designer. She wants it to feel fast, graphic and confident. Acid look, night energy.
Make a 15 s showreel that shows what an incredible motion designer you are.
briefs.note: The most common gallery prompt: no studio or designer name is given, and the name slot is verbatim, so it must be reported missing.
